SELECT CAR_NO FROM ( SELECT CAR_NO FROM ( SELECT CAR_NO, SUBSTR(CAR_NO, -1) AS LAST_DIGIT,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY SUBSTR(CAR_NO, -1) ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) AS RN
FROM TM_NUMPLATE_LIST
WHERE USE_YN = 'N' AND PROC_ST IN ('M_END', 'S_REQ', 'S_ING', 'S_END')
AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 3, 1) NOT IN ('하', '허', '호') AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 4, 1) NOT IN ('하', '허', '호')
AND GOVT_ID = #{GOVT_ID} AND NUM_KIND = #{NUM_KIND} AND HOLE_YN = #{HOLE_YN} AND SEAL_YN = #{SEAL_YN}
AND SPECIAL_YN = 'Y'
AND CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{WANT_CAR_NO} || '%'
AND ASSIGN_CD LIKE '%' || #{ASSIGN_CD} || DECODE( SUBSTR(ASSIGN_CD, 1, 4), 'BITS', '', '%' )
AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 1, 2) >= DECODE( #{CAR_KD}, '70', '01', '80', '70', '97', '80' )
AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, 1, 2) < DECODE( #{CAR_KD}, '97', '98', #{CAR_KD} )
AND ( #{CONDITION} = 'NOT' OR ( LENGTH(#{CONDITION}) = 2 AND REGEXP_LIKE( #{CONDITION}, '^[0-9]{2}$' ) AND SUBSTR(CAR_NO, -1) = SUBSTR(#{CONDITION}, 2, 1) ) )
AND CAR_NO NOT IN
#{carNo}
)
WHERE RN <= CASE LAST_DIGIT WHEN '0' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_0}, 0) WHEN '1' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_1}, 0) WHEN '2' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_2}, 0) WHEN '3' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_3}, 0) WHEN '4' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_4}, 0) WHEN '5' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_5}, 0) WHEN '6' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_6}, 0) WHEN '7' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_7}, 0) WHEN '8' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_8}, 0) WHEN '9' THEN 2 - NVL(#{LAST_COUNT_9}, 0) ELSE 0 END
ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE )
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{LIMIT}

60 AND SUBSTR (PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT (NM.TEL_NO), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.INSTALL_TEL_NO),'-',''),-8) AND 1 = NVL2( TNI.IMAGE4, CASE WHEN ((TT.TASK_CD= 'UTRNS' OR TT.TASK_CD = 'RTRNS') AND (TNI.IMAGE6 IS NULL AND TNI.IMAGE6_PATH IS NULL)) THEN 1 WHEN TC.READY_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN INSTR('|N_INS|N_DLV|N_REQ|S_REQ|S_END|J_REQ|J_ING|J_WTX|J_END|D_REQ|D_ING|D_END|D_DAC|D_MAN|D_PAY|D_PAM|D_CON|RET|END|', '|' ||PROC_ST|| '|') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AND 1 = NVL2( TNI.IMAGE4_PATH, CASE WHEN ((TT.TASK_CD= 'UTRNS' OR TT.TASK_CD = 'RTRNS') AND TNI.IMAGE6_PATH IS NULL) THEN 1 WHEN TC.READY_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN INSTR('|N_INS|N_DLV|N_REQ|S_REQ|S_END|J_REQ|J_ING|J_WTX|J_END|D_REQ|D_ING|D_END|D_DAC|D_MAN|D_PAY|D_PAM|D_CON|RET|END|', '|' ||PROC_ST|| '|') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AND TS.PROC_ST != 'T_CAN' AND ((TS.COMPANY_ID = 'CB407' AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('S_REQ', 'N_DLV')) OR (TS.COMPANY_ID <> 'CB407'))
AND ((TC.INSTALL_DT IS NOT NULL AND TC.INSTALL_TM IS NOT NULL) OR (TS.COMPANY_ID = 'CB407' AND TS.PROC_ST = 'N_DLV'))
AND TB.BUY_NM LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%'
AND (TS.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%' or TC.POST_CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID AS SERVICE_ID, TC.CAR_NO AS CAR_NO, TC.POST_CAR_NO AS POST_CAR_NO, TS.COMPANY_ID, TM.BUY_NM AS BUY_NM, TS.PROC_ST AS PROC_ST, '' AS EXPIRE_DT, TNI.IMAGE1 AS IMAGE1, TNI.IMAGE2 AS IMAGE2, TNI.IMAGE3 AS IMAGE3, TNI.IMAGE4 AS IMAGE4, TNI.IMAGE1_PATH AS IMAGE1_PATH, TNI.IMAGE2_PATH AS IMAGE2_PATH, TNI.IMAGE3_PATH AS IMAGE3_PATH, TNI.IMAGE4_PATH AS IMAGE4_PATH, TNI.IMAGE6_PATH AS IMAGE6_PATH, TNI.IMAGE_PATH_YN AS IMAGE_PATH_YN, '' AS CARD_YN, '' AS CARD_PAY_YN, TO_CHAR(TC.INSTALL_DT, 'YY/MM/DD') AS INSTALL_DT, NVL2(TC.INSTALL_TM,SUBSTR(TC.INSTALL_TM,0,2)||':'|| SUBSTR(TC.INSTALL_TM,-1)||'0','')AS INSTALL_TM, SUBSTR (pkg_common.fn_decrypt (LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR), 1, INSTR (pkg_common.fn_decrypt (LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR), ' ', 1, 2) - 1) AS LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR, TC.TASK_CD AS NUM_GB, DECODE(TM.MDF_GB, 'BNUM', 'Y', '') AS ETC5 FROM TM_NUM_MANAGER NM, TR_MODIFY TM, TR_CARNO_DETACH TC, TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NUMPLATE_IMAGES TNI, TM_CODE CD WHERE SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(NM.TEL_NO),'-',''),-8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{TEL_NO},'-',''),-8) AND NM.MANAGER_NM = TC.INSTALL_NM AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TC.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TM.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TNI.SERVICE_ID(+) AND CD.GROUP_ID = 'TPRST' AND TS.PROC_ST = CD.CODE_ID AND TC.FILENAME1 IS NULL AND (TC.ETC2 != 'Y' OR TC.ETC2 IS NULL) AND TS.REQUEST_DT >= SYSDATE - 60 AND SUBSTR (PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT (NM.TEL_NO), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.INSTALL_TEL_NO),'-',''),-8) AND 1 = NVL2(TNI.IMAGE4, 0, CASE WHEN INSTR('|N_INS|N_DLV|N_REQ|S_REQ|S_END|J_REQ|J_ING|J_WTX|J_END|D_REQ|D_ING|D_END|D_DAC|D_MAN|D_PAY|D_PAM|D_CON|RET|END|', '|' ||PROC_ST|| '|') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AND 1 = NVL2(TNI.IMAGE4_PATH, 0, CASE WHEN INSTR('|N_INS|N_DLV|N_REQ|S_REQ|S_END|J_REQ|J_ING|J_WTX|J_END|D_REQ|D_ING|D_END|D_DAC|D_MAN|D_PAY|D_PAM|D_CON|RET|END|', '|' ||PROC_ST|| '|') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AND TS.PROC_ST != 'T_CAN' AND ((TS.COMPANY_ID = 'CB407' AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('S_REQ', 'N_DLV')) OR (TS.COMPANY_ID <> 'CB407'))
AND ((TC.INSTALL_DT IS NOT NULL AND TC.INSTALL_TM IS NOT NULL) OR (TS.COMPANY_ID = 'CB407' AND TS.PROC_ST = 'N_DLV'))
AND TM.BUY_NM LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%'
AND (TS.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%' or TC.POST_CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CONDITION} || '%')
UNION ALL SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID AS SERVICE_ID, '회수대상X' AS CAR_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO AS POST_CAR_NO, TS.COMPANY_ID, (SELECT COMPANY_NM FROM TM_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_ID = TS.COMPANY_ID) AS BUY_NM, TS.PROC_ST AS PROC_ST, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPIRE_DT, TNI.IMAGE1 AS IMAGE1, TNI.IMAGE2 AS IMAGE2, TNI.IMAGE3 AS IMAGE3, TNI.IMAGE4 AS IMAGE4, TNI.IMAGE1_PATH AS IMAGE1_PATH, TNI.IMAGE2_PATH AS IMAGE2_PATH, TNI.IMAGE3_PATH AS IMAGE3_PATH, TNI.IMAGE4_PATH AS IMAGE4_PATH, TNI.IMAGE6_PATH AS IMAGE6_PATH, TNI.IMAGE_PATH_YN AS IMAGE_PATH_YN, TN.CARD_YN AS CARD_YN, TN.CARD_PAY_YN AS CARD_PAY_YN, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'YY/MM/DD') AS INSTALL_DT, '' AS INSTALL_TM, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'DLVGB' AND CODE_ID = TC.DELIVERY_GB) AS LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR, TC.TASK_CD AS NUM_GB, '' as ETC5 FROM TM_NUM_MANAGER NM, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TC, TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NUMPLATE_IMAGES TNI, TM_CODE CD WHERE SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(NM.TEL_NO),'-',''),-8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{TEL_NO},'-',''),-8) AND NM.MANAGER_NM = TC.INSTALL_NM AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TC.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TNI.SERVICE_ID(+) AND CD.GROUP_ID = 'TPRST' AND TS.PROC_ST = CD.CODE_ID AND TC.FILENAME1 IS NULL AND (TC.ETC2 != 'Y' OR TC.ETC2 IS NULL) AND TS.REQUEST_DT >= SYSDATE - 60 AND (TC.INSTALL_YN IS NULL OR TC.INSTALL_YN != 'Y') AND SUBSTR(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(NM.TEL_NO), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.INSTALL_TEL_NO), '-', ''), -8) AND TS.PROC_ST NOT IN ('T_CAN', 'DEL')
AND ( TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) OR TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) OR TRUNC(SYSDATE) = ( SELECT MAX(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - D.DAY_OFFSET) FROM ( SELECT LEVEL AS DAY_OFFSET FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 31 ) D WHERE (TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - D.DAY_OFFSET - TRUNC(TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) - D.DAY_OFFSET, 'IW')) BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND INSTR( ',' || NVL(( SELECT REPLACE(H.DETAIL_NM, ' ', '') FROM TM_CODE H WHERE H.GROUP_ID = 'ETC..' , INSTALL_DT ASC, INSTALL_TM ASC

NVL(TN.MEMO_TX, TM.MEMO_TX) AS TN_MEMO_TX, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TB.CARP_ADDRESS) || ' ' || PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TB.CARP_ADDRESS_DT) AS CARP_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(TC.INSU_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSU_START_DT FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_CARNO_DETACH TC ON TC.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_TRNSNAME TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_TRNSNAME_BUY TB ON TB.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_MODIFY TM ON TM.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_NEWCAR NC ON NC.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUBSTR(REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TC.INSTALL_TEL_NO), '-', ''), -8) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{TEL_NO}, '-', ''), -8) )
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SERVICE SET AUTO_YN = 'N', PROC_ST = 'S_REQ', JUDGE_ST = 'S_REQ', UPD_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND PROC_ST IN ('N_REQ', 'N_INS', 'N_DLV', '번호판처리요청', '번호판발송요청', '번호판탈부착요청', '배송요청', '사무실배송요청')
UPDATE TR_CARNO_DETACH SET INSTALL_YN = 'Y', UPD_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND (INSTALL_YN IS NULL OR INSTALL_YN != 'Y')
